item.title: Davao Doctors Hospital leads with first PhilHealth-accredited post-transplant program
item.description: For many patients, a kidney transplant means a second chance at life. To protect this gift, Davao Doctors Hospital (DDH) launched the country’s first PhilHealth-accredited Post-Kidney Transplant (Post-KT) Essential Services Program under the Z Benefit Package. A milestone in Philippine healthcare Accredited under PhilHealth Circular 2025-0012, the program provides comprehensive care for transplant recipients and living donors.
